channel.title: Wildfire Local Test Feed
channel.description: Original test items for HTC NewsReader on the Wildfire.

item.title: Local feed works
item.author: test@example.invalid (Local Test)
item.description: If HTC NewsReader shows this item, it can load a handpicked feed from the phone itself.

item.title: Second item with plain text

item.title: Third item with CDATA
item.description: This item uses CDATA. It also contains bold markup and an ampersand: A & B.

item.title: Fourth item with an entity
item.description: Entities such as & and < should decode correctly.

item.title: Fifth item, older date
item.description: The app should sort this below the newer items if sorting is enabled.
